notes.title: Soundtrack update and great news!
notes.notes:
Hi humans! ːfofinoː

A Building Full of Cats Soundtrack has been updated and now displays the names and images of the tracks on the player. 
Sorry for taking this long to update this, but this has been a year of work non-stop and we hope that shows on the second semester. ːawkwardsmileː
Also, the game was updated to show the new music credits. Now you'll see the credits for the currently selected soundtrack.

DEVCATS NEWS
We are happy to inform you that we now have a Discord channel!
The purrfect place to see cute cats and discuss with other kind-hearted humans about our species.
Enter for news, Devcats pictures, giveaways, and more. ːlovecatː

The best mews of the week:
Your cat can be an NPC on A Tower Full of Cats! 
We'll have a contest on our Discord where your cat can win a spot on our next game, in the same art style from the cats on A Castle Full of Cats.

Join our Discord now and be notified when the contest starts! ːwinkycatː

Bonus:
Meet Pietra & Vivi, new characters from A Tower Full of Cats!
https://i.imgur.com/FcsUxJ5.png
We have rescued them last December and have been fostering them ever since (Pietra already found her forever home, but Vivi is still waiting for hers ːcathspawː )

A Tower Full of Cats will be released next semester, stay tuned!

Love & Purrs,
The Devcats ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ

notes.title: Update and News
notes.notes:
UPDATE

 Traditional Chinese is now available in the game
 Corrected some typos
 Fixed minor visual glitches


What's next?
• More Languages
We already hired Polish and Turkish translators, not just for this game but also for our upcoming games.

• Hint system
We are working on a hint system.
These new updates are coming in the following weeks.


The future...
We have received several requests for a DLC or sequel. We already have something very cute in mind, but with a little twist...

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2070550/A_Castle_Full_of_Cats/

"A Castle Full of Cats" is a hidden object game with a metroidvania structure, so... this is a catvania!

Fofiño was cursed by an evil force and transformed every cat in the castle into a dark (yet cute) creature. 
Now only Lily can save her soulmate and release the castle from the spell!

Fear not, our dear humans: this castle is still going to be heartwarming and surely put a smile on your face! ♥ (Hopefully!)

It's going to be a bigger game, with several rooms and many alternate paths. Check out the page for more info!

"A Castle Full of Cats" is coming on October 28, to celebrate Halloween!

That's all for today. See you again, soon!
Love & Purrs,
Devcats ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ

notes.title: Patch Notes and more
notes.notes:
Hello, humans!
We can't be grateful enough to you!
A Building Full of Cats got 80 reviews in 2 days! 
Thank you everyone who's helping us to be successful cats and having a better life!
Thus, we can also help other cats in need! ♥

We've made several small patchs in the last 2 days.
Here's a list of what has changed:

 Changed some render properties to make the game less demanding 
 Fixed Fofiño fading animation bug
 Fixed sometimes ESC not working on 5th and 6th floor after fiding Fofiño
 Fixed minor visual glitches
 Fixed japanese and simplified chinese pointing to the wrong language


Coming soon
We've just received the Traditional Chinese localization and we're working on it.
We are also hiring localization for more languages.

https://i.imgur.com/DHjs5nU.png
Above, Fofiño sends his best regards (specially for those humans who decided to go "yes" in you-know-when)

See you again, soon!
Love & Purrs,
Devcats ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ
